headline: Flagler remain unbeaten against conference opponents
dek: Flagler have lost once all season, at Florida Southern in September, and are yet to lose to a conference side. Saturday's win over Middle Georgia State was their widest of the season, and they have conceded 17 goals across all their matches.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Flagler's 34 goals are more than USC Aiken and Georgia Southwestern have scored between them, and twelve different players have shared them.

wire.line: Georgia Southwestern are the only side in the conference yet to win a conference match.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, every one of them from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Middle Georgia State have conceded 43 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, while scoring 26.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored eleven of Middle Georgia State's 26 goals from 47 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Isaac Calderon has scored nine of North Georgia's 34 goals from 40 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Finn Weigelt has scored nine of Flagler's 34 goals from 31 shots.

last_match.line: Flagler were also the last side to beat Middle Georgia State, and have won every conference match since their draw with North Georgia.

next_match.line: North Georgia won the September meeting at home; Middle Georgia State have conceded more goals than any side in the conference.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
